background: OCBC is Singapore's second-largest bank, funded by Singapore dollar deposits and lending across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Greater China, with Great Eastern as its insurance arm and Bank of Singapore in private banking.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest at AA-, all on a stable outlook. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 15.7% at the median for Asian banks and leverage of 6.5% in the top quarter, though they have fallen 1.3 points and 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is the weak spot on paper, with LCR of 131% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter, both broadly flat. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
